The documents I have do not contain any 2026 HARP eligibility rules, so I cannot state any.

What the Fannie Mae documents do say: the primary Single-Family Loan Performance dataset excludes HARP (Home Affordable Refinance Program) and Refi Plus loans, and the separate HARP dataset is a subset of Fannie Mae's overall HARP population. The dataset FAQ says Fannie Mae does not anticipate adding new HARP loan acquisitions to the dataset, and the HARP data is updated quarterly. The file layout glossary only mentions HARP in the LTV (loan to value) field note: an appraisal is not required for HARP eligibility if Fannie Mae waived the property fieldwork requirement. No eligibility criteria for 2026 appear.

Sources: sf-loan-performance-dataset-faqs.pdf pages 1-3; crt-file-layout-and-glossary.pdf page 2.

According to the Fannie Mae FAQ, the primary (fixed-rate) dataset excludes: Home Affordable Refinance Program (HARP) loans, Refi Plus loans, interest-only loans, balloon amortization loans, loans with prepayment penalties, loans with LTV greater than 97%, Alt-A loans, loans subject to long-term standby commitments, and loans sold with lender recourse or subject to certain other third-party risk-sharing arrangements (other than primary mortgage insurance). It also does not include adjustable-rate, government-insured loans, and the population is limited to fixed-rate, fully amortizing, full-documentation loans with original term of at least 5 and under 35 years. Loans in Credit Risk Transfer risk-sharing deals are not excluded by that criterion.

Source: sf-loan-performance-dataset-faqs.pdf pages 1-3.
